rules.message: RFC 7807 is obsolete. RFC 9457 replaced it in 2023.
rules.fix: Name RFC 9457 and use application/problem+json with type, title, status, detail, and a stable code (APD-02).

rules.message: X-RateLimit-* and RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset are old forms. The current IETF draft -11 has only RateLimit and RateLimit-Policy.
rules.fix: Answer 429 with Retry-After. Add RateLimit and RateLimit-Policy only when the team accepts a draft, and write 'draft -11' (APD-09).

rules.message: OpenAPI 3.0 is for an existing contract only. A new contract uses 3.1 or 3.2 with JSON Schema 2020-12.
rules.fix: For a new contract, write openapi: 3.1.2 (or 3.2.1, APD-08). Keep 3.0 in an existing contract and suppress with a reason.

rules.message: OpenAPI 3.1 and 3.2 have no nullable keyword. Tools ignore it, so the field is not nullable for a client generator.
A verb in a path hides the HTTP method. Clients and agents guess the wrong method.
rules.fix: Use a plural noun and the method: GET /orders, POST /orders, DELETE /orders/{id}. Put an action on POST /orders/{id}/cancel (APD-01).

rules.message: Offset paging skips or repeats rows on a large or changing set, and a deep offset is slow.
rules.fix: Keep offset only for a small, stable set with page numbers in the UI. Else use an opaque cursor with a limit that has a maximum (APD-03).
